brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of free area, and clear any obstruction before the forecast heat event according to SOP-015. Because this unit has ONAN cooling, verify that the permissible load is reduced for high ambient temperatures as instructed in MG-021. Apply the loading restrictions specified in MG-021 to manage the risks associated with this asset's advanced age as outlined in MG-023.
